Exam Security
In-Center Edition · August 2026
Opening Address
In-Person ≠ Secure
Sanjoe Jose (Talview)
Why the assumption that in-center delivery is inherently safe no longer holds — and why the test center is the next frontier.
Session 1
The In-Center Threat File
Erica Brown (ASIS International), Laurent De Laere (Televic assessmentQ), Ashwin Arun (Talview)
Smuggled devices and wearables · proxy candidates at check-in · staff collusion and insider risk · content harvesting inside centers — and what centers are actually catching.
Session 2
Running a Modern Test Center Network
Michael Goodine (Independent Analyst), Charles L. Scott Jr (Illinois Institute of Technology), Steve Kazin (Talview)
AI-assisted identity and check-in · digital monitoring on center workstations · auditing distributed center networks · blending in-center and remote delivery.
Session 3
The In-Center Blueprint
Bridget Herd (Pearson VUE), Ada Woo (Ascend Learning), Rajeev Menon (AI Dome)
What a modernized test center looks like — drawn from real-world, in-production examples. Published post-event as a standalone asset.
Closing Note
A Forward Look
Chaitanya Pattapu (Talview)
A forward look and an invitation to continue the conversation.
Interview Security
India Edition · July 2026
Opening Keynote
Every Fact. Every Claim. Every Answer.
Why hiring integrity in India is no longer a regional HR concern. It is a global enterprise risk — and the organizations getting ahead of it now will define the standard for everyone else.
When the Hiring Decision Is Local but the Risk Is Global
Your India TA team owns the hire. Your global parent owns the risk. The accountability gap between them is where Gen AI cheating finds its best opportunity — and how leading GCCs are closing it.
Zero Tolerance, Zero Playbook: How BFSI Is Navigating Hiring Integrity Right Now
Regulated institutions. RBI and SEBI compliance expectations. KYC discipline that should extend to hiring but often doesn't — a peer panel with no frameworks and no vendor talk, just honest conversation.
Inside the Gen AI Fraud Playbook Targeting Tech Roles
Proxy developers. AI-coached technical interviews. Day-one access provisioning. What a fraudulent IT hire with legitimate credentials can actually do once inside — and the minimum standard every India tech hiring operation should meet.
Closing
The India Hiring Integrity Pledge
Leave with more than insights. Leave with a personal commitment to clean, verified, trustworthy hiring at scale in India.
Agentic AI Edition · May 2026
The Integrity Gap Where Exam Risk Actually Breaks Down
Sanjoe Jose, Founder & CEO, Talview
Why the integrity gap where exam security breaks down represents a critical inflection point in assessment risk — and what the industry must do now.
Agentic AI & Orchestrated Cheating — The Next Threat Wave
Rory McCorkle (Strasz Assessment Systems), Charles Mayenga (Fitch Learning), Steve Kazin (Talview)
Autonomous AI agents can now execute coordinated, multi-step cheating attacks that bypass browser lockdowns, identity checks, and behavioral detection. This session maps the threat landscape and what's coming next.
Institutions Fight Back — What Is Actually Working
Claire McCauley (Cambridge University Press & Assessment), Scott DeWolfe (SF Dept. of Public Health), Laurent Goldsztejn (dbt Labs), Ashwin Arun (Talview)
Real-world detection, deterrence, and response playbooks. No theory — only what exam boards and certification bodies are actually deploying today.
Why the Most Dangerous Cheating Now Hides Between Exams, Not Within Them
Paul Muir (risr/), Liberty Munson (Microsoft), Isabelle Gonthier (PSI & ETS), Rajeev Menon (AI DOME)
From session-level monitoring to program-wide intelligence — and the ethical line that comes with it.
IT Edition · April 2026
The Trust Infrastructure Imperative
Why hiring integrity is no longer an HR problem — it's a business risk that starts at the top.
The IT Fraud Landscape: What's Actually Happening in 2026
Ghost engineers. Identity fraud. AI-generated candidates. A clear-eyed look at how bad it's gotten — and why traditional screening is no longer enough.
What Talent Leaders Are Actually Seeing: Unfiltered
Straight talk from the people in the trenches — the patterns, red flags, and hard lessons IT hiring leaders aren't talking about publicly. Until now.
From Awareness to Action: How Leaders Are Building the Answer
The frameworks, tools, and cultural shifts that forward-thinking organizations are using to build fraud-resistant hiring from day one.
The IT Hiring Integrity Pledge
Leave with more than insights — leave with a personal commitment to clean, verified, trustworthy hiring.
Gen AI Edition · Feb 2026
The Exam Security Imperative
Why protecting exam credibility is becoming non-negotiable in an AI-enabled world.
The GenAI Cheating Shift — How Artificial Intelligence Is Rewriting Exams
Dan Hughes (Talogy), Michael Nemarich (NAATI), Jarret M. Dyer (Surpass Assessment), Radhika Bhatia (Talview)
How real-time AI assistance and external orchestration are quietly undermining traditional exam controls.
Inside the Breakdown — What Exam Leaders and Institutions Are Seeing
Jouko van Aggelen (Aon Assessments), Paul Edelblut (Vantage Labs), Miguel Prieto (Open Assessment Technologies), Harjoth Singh (Talview)
Recurring fraud patterns, trust failures, and where exams are starting to fall apart.
Trust Before Scale — Adopting Agentic AI Without Breaking Credibility
Liberty Munson (Microsoft), Paul Muir (risr/), Sundar Nagarathnam, Rajeev Menon (AI DOME)
How exam leaders can adopt AI responsibly by proving fairness, transparency, and defensibility first — ensuring AI strengthens exam credibility without replacing human judgment.
